name: The Harbour Lights
bio: High-energy rock outfit from Newcastle's inner west. Four-piece band delivering anthemic originals and killer covers since 2018. Regular performers at the Wickham Hotel and Cambridge Hotel.
availability: Available weekends and Friday nights. Book at least 4 weeks in advance for weddings.

name: Bella Rose
bio: Singer-songwriter Bella Rose blends folk storytelling with country warmth. Intimate acoustic performances perfect for wineries, cafes, and private events. Based in the Hunter Valley.
availability: Available most weekends. Daytime and evening slots. No travel surcharge within 50km of Newcastle.

name: Neon Static
bio: Newcastle's premier electronic duo. Neon Static fuse driving synths, pulsing beats and soaring vocals into a live electronic experience unlike anything else in the Hunter. Perfect for festivals and corporate events.
availability: Available for festivals, corporate events and private parties. Minimum 2-hour set. PA and lighting rig available.

name: The Blue Jacks
bio: Sophisticated blues and jazz trio bringing a cool, soulful vibe to any occasion. Perfect background music for corporate dinners, weddings and winery events. Over 15 years performing together.
availability: Weeknights and weekends. Corporate enquiries welcome. Also available as a duo for smaller events.
